about: Inkling 2 Mini (official NVFP4/MXFP8 checkpoint) on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell at 1,048,576 tokens (the model's full window) with bf16 KV and 128 sequences, upstream vllm/vllm-openai:inkling-2-mini image unmodified, CUDA graphs to 1,024 tokens. With the DSpark drafter: the image's vLLM kernels are built for sm_100/103, so the drafter's KV-cache write has no sm_120 kernel; the config file is a sitecustomize (on PYTHONPATH) that registers a torch version of that one op. Draft width follows the batch (num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size).

config.text:
# sitecustomize for vllm/vllm-openai:inkling-2-mini@sha256:c2dc759f (Inkling 2 Mini's DSpark drafter on sm_120).
# That image builds vLLM's own CUDA kernels for sm_100/sm_103 and older, not sm_120 (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, RTX 50),
# so the KV-cache write _C_cache_ops::reshape_and_cache_flash fails with "no kernel image is available". Only the
# DSpark drafter calls it; the target model's attention writes its cache another way. On PYTHONPATH, this registers a
# torch-indexing version of that one op once vLLM's kernel library loads: the same values in the same slots, bf16/auto
# cache only. Drop it when an image ships sm_120 kernels.
import importlib.abc
import importlib.machinery
import sys

_LIB = "vllm._C_stable_libtorch"
_keep = []


def _install():
    import torch

    def reshape_and_cache_flash(key, value, key_cache, value_cache, slot_mapping, kv_cache_dtype, k_scale, v_scale):
        if kv_cache_dtype not in ("auto", "bfloat16", "float16"):
            raise NotImplementedError(f"sm120 kv write: cache dtype {kv_cache_dtype} not handled")
        n = slot_mapping.shape[0]  # key/value may be padded; slot_mapping is not
        s = slot_mapping.clamp(min=0)  # -1 is padding; slot 0 sits in vLLM's null block, never given to a request
        bs = key_cache.shape[1]
        b, o = s // bs, s % bs
        key_cache[b, o] = key[:n].to(key_cache.dtype)
        value_cache[b, o] = value[:n].to(value_cache.dtype)

    lib = torch.library.Library("_C_cache_ops", "IMPL")
    lib.impl("reshape_and_cache_flash", reshape_and_cache_flash, "CUDA")
    _keep.append(lib)  # the registration lives as long as the Library object


class _Hook(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
    def find_spec(self, name, path, target=None):
        if name != _LIB:
            return None
        sys.meta_path.remove(self)
        spec = importlib.machinery.PathFinder.find_spec(name, path)
        if spec is None:
            return None
        run = spec.loader.exec_module

        def exec_module(module):
            run(module)
            _install()

        spec.loader.exec_module = exec_module
        return spec


sys.meta_path.insert(0, _Hook())
